description: File an entry intent (an Agreement in 'pending', or 'accepted' in open mode) against a post, slot or mission. Same rules, receipts and Seeds as POST /api/work-entry. Stake never auto-converts to entry.

agreement_class.description: Optional agreement class string (open; default work entry).
agreement_class.title: Agreement Class

idempotency_key.description: Optional: replaying the same key returns the same entry.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

objects.description: Optional open object refs (node_id, entity_id, formation_id, economic_terms_id, ...). Stored as given; never required.
objects.title: Objects

participation_ref.description: Optional reference to your participation record (not an Agreement).
participation_ref.title: Participation Ref

pitch.description: Why you / what you will deliver. Max 4000 chars.
pitch.title: Pitch

name: entry.file
